{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the gemstone|the alias of [[Facet Anamor]], or the [[Diamond-class cruiser/Legends|''Diamond''-class cruiser]] warship}}
{{Citation}}
{{Quote|Finding a real diamond should not be that difficult―carbon ''is'' one of the more common elements.|[[Elegos A'Kla]] to [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]]|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
'''Diamonds''' were gemstones valued by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. They could be worth anywhere from one thousand to three thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[Coruscant Standard Carat]]. A large number of mines were located on [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]].

A [[Stylus/Legends|stylus]] used by [[Yaru Korsin]] in [[3000 BBY]] was made of diamond.

[[Uvak]]-mounted [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] of the [[Alanciari military]]'s [[Alanciari air force|air force]] successfully used diamonds as a flak projectile weapon.

Diamond and [[Boron/Legends|boron]] were the primary components in a [[diamond boron missile]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] used a diamond in the construction of [[Corran Horn's lightsaber|his]] [[Dual-phase lightsaber/Legends|dual-phase lightsaber]]. However, the first gem he used turned out to be [[Kubaz xirkonia]] instead, which burned out during a confrontation with [[Shala]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Corran later replaced it with a real diamond.
